settings.profile: Unscaled concatenation of six6-action probability distributions; no division by sqrt(6).
settings.heldout_label: Initial discovery label, same baseline continuation; no held-out refitting.
settings.qualification_scope: Existing full-normal visibility/recovery gates; no new quotient nomination gate. Invisible/phase-only fibers retain category-specific inconclusive outcomes.
settings.stop_rule: No discovery-bank expansion, new hidden-profile rescue or continuation training after absent primary phase sensitivity, failed held-out closure or incomplete capped cohort.
settings.launch_condition: Both original1024 cohorts complete with zero candidates; any dense candidate instead receives causal validation.
